svg.title: Throughput is set by your narrowest stage
svg.desc: Pipeline diagram showing a load balancer handling fifty thousand requests per second, application servers handling twenty thousand, a cache handling one hundred thousand, and a database handling only five thousand, making the database the bottleneck that caps end to end throughput at five thousand requests per second.

svg.text: Each stage can absorb a different rate. The smallest number wins.
